note: A scratch repository with a tracked .claude/settings.json (a PreToolUse hook that touches a marker) and a tracked .mcp.json (a server that writes a marker when started). With --setting-sources user --strict-mcp-config neither marker appeared and system/init lists only the anthrex server; anthrex's --settings hooks fired (PreToolUse/PostToolUse/Stop and the rest). The same session without the two flags wrote both markers and listed the project server (source project) in mcp_servers; that run is not committed because its init lists the capturing user's own MCP servers. Captured with a scrubbed environment (env -i with only HOME, PATH, USER, LOGNAME, SHELL, TERM, LANG), because the capture ran inside a Claude Code session whose CLAUDE_CODE_*/CLAUDECODE variables change how a child claude behaves (transcript saving off, messaging the parent). No ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: the subscription login was used.
